evidence.reason: Both `drain-alive` and `drain-ambiguous` still dispatch to the same seed-driven `drain_refuse_phase(args)` handler, while `--seed` remains an independent choice. Nothing in the visible dispatch path rejects a conflicting seed before running the probe, so `drain-alive --seed ambiguous` can execute the ambiguous scenario while the phase name/artifact remains `drain-alive`. That is a real evidence-mislabeling bug. The smallest fix is to reject a phase/seed mismatch as a usage error, or derive the seed from the phase name.
